title: Does the Sea Mirror the Sky?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noon. Taking my lunchbox with me,
I headed up to the rooftop, where—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Ehehe, over here~
It's me, Aston Machan~”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was Aston Machan, waving both hands toward the sky.
Just what was she waving at? Looking up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is that... a helicopter?
It seemed to have just flown past right over Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “It's a news helicopter. A friend told me that they're filming Tracen Academy from way, way up high.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Noticing my presence, Aston Machan offered an explanation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If their goal was a wide landscape shot of the whole campus,
even if they noticed someone, they wouldn't necessarily zoom in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, Aston Machan kept smiling toward the sky.
Wagering on the slenderest hope that, just maybe, they might capture her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Machan's dream is to become a mascot, you see.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“And not just an ordinary mascot.
A world-spanning super mascot.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Popping up everywhere, finding my way into everyone's hands...
I want to be that kind of super—no, ultra-super mascot!”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“The helicopter looks like it's swimming too. Swoosh, swoosh.
Ah, the sky really is so much like the ocean, isn't it~”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wants as many people as possible to remember her.
That is Aston Machan's dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In races filled with countless exceptional horsegirls,
etching oneself deeply and indelibly into someone's memory is no easy task.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“I wonder if the distant, faraway sky will ever feel close someday?
Just like the sea that everyone eventually reaches.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gazed up at the sky just as Aston Machan did.
To make her cherished dream come true, what can I do as her Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Haah, haah... haaah... phew...”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Okaay. Off Machan goes~”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Aston Machan run,
I contemplated our upcoming training routine.
choice_data_list: Overcoming weaknesses, leaning further into her strengths...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things we should do, things we must do.
Things we want to achieve, hurdles we need to clear.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“That's why leaving a mark is what matters most.
A mark that won't fade, even after I'm gone.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To keep winning and preserve her image in people's minds, we'll have to
tackle a mountain of challenges. That's just how grand Aston Machan's dream is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “My personal camera lens. Whom are you capturing right now~?”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Those orange eyes.
Rather than the distant sky, right now, they're focused squarely on me.
choice_data_list: I was thinking about our training.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Hmm, hmm. In other words, you were thinking about Machan~”
choice_data_list: And ways to help people remember you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Hehe. Exactly. Just like how you
remembered me so clearly, Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“There are so many lives in this world.
And each and every one exists in their own unique way.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“For Machan to leave a mark among so 'many',
Machan needs 'many' herself.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze fixed straight ahead, as if signaling her unyielding
resolve to spare no effort whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “I'm counting on you.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Actions speak louder than thoughts. Move forward solely for the sake of the wish.
Devotedly, straight ahead. Overcoming any wall that stands in the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I renewed my silent vow to give it my all so that Aston Machan's image
would be etched deeply, indelibly into the hearts of many.
